speaker: alice
text: First up, some genuinely lovely news from out on the water. Researchers have reported encouraging signs of coral recovery on parts of the Great Barrier Reef in the latest health survey, which is the kind of update we love leading with.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah it's not all doom and gloom out there, the reef's a tough old thing and it's showing some real resilience. Doesn't mean we stop looking after it, but it's a nice reminder that recovery is possible when we give nature half a chance.

speaker: alice
text: Speaking of giving nature a hand, volunteers right across Queensland have been out this week planting thousands of native trees as part of a spring bushland restoration push. Community groups getting their hands dirty for a good cause, you love to see it.
